The post-gate seal remains correct and complete. Both live gate steps consume the exact pre-gate output emitted by their own sealing phase; malformed or absent expectations fail before target-controlled code runs; every gate profile reaches the post-body comparison; and recomputation fails closed. The throwaway-index digest preserves the real HEAD/index/worktree, covers tracked edits, deletions, and untracked publishable files while excluding ignored build output, and the worker lane additionally binds it to the exact patch bytes later published. The self-tests exercise the helper, end-to-end mutation and deletion refusals, ignored-output success, missing/malformed/unreadable failure arms, output-name seams, and exact workflow wiring with a deletion control. I found no correctness, soundness, test-vacuity, or security issue in the diff.
